verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's first-party docs state that official SDKs exist for six major languages (PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java, .NET) for API v2. A sandbox API and a Job Builder support building against the API. The evidence is a single vendor claim with no SDK-level depth. Missing for 10: per-SDK documentation depth (coverage, maintenance, examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: For API v2, official PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET SDKs are available.
The sandbox API allows you to perform unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming your credits.
